title: Transform and retain elements in place
summary: Sort, deduplicate, filter and edit vector elements without requiring a replacement collection.

binding.clue: Modifier allowing repeated in-place vector transformations

sort.clue: Slice method putting values into ascending order before duplicate removal

deduplicate.clue: Method removing consecutive repeated values from the sorted vector

retain.clue: Vector method keeping only entries accepted by a predicate

iterate.clue: Keyword visiting each exclusive reference yielded by the iterator

exclusive.clue: Method yielding exclusive references to the vector’s elements

dereference.clue: Operator accessing the integer behind an exclusive reference for multiplication assignment

equal.clue: Macro checking the sorted, deduplicated, positive and doubled values

truncate.clue: Method shortening the vector to at most the requested length
